deal_data.subtitle: Artemis Gold to acquire Vista Gold and the Mt Todd gold project, Northern Territory, Australia
dataNotes: Deal terms, premiums, ownership, termination fee, conditions, timeline and advisers: Artemis Gold and Vista Gold news releases, Sep 21, 2026.

Mt Todd (Vista Gold), effective Jul 25, 2025: P&P reserve 5.19 Moz (171,975 kt at 0.94 g/t); M&I 9.12 Moz including reserves, so 3.93 Moz excluding them; inferred 1.43 Moz. Source: the news releases and the acquisition presentation appendix.

Artemis Gold 2026 guidance: 265,000–290,000 oz at AISC of US$925–1,025 per ounce sold, trending to the top of the AISC range (Q2 2026 results release, Aug 6, 2026). Combined AISC is Artemis Gold's, as Vista Gold has no production.

Artemis Gold (Blackwater), from the company's reserves and resources page: P&P reserve 8.0 Moz gold (334.3 Mt at 0.75 g/t, effective Sep 10, 2021) and 62.3 Moz silver; M&I 11.7 Moz gold including reserves (596.8 Mt at 0.61 g/t, effective May 5, 2020), so 3.7 Moz excluding them; inferred 0.25 Moz. The reserve estimate predates first gold in January 2025 and is not adjusted for production since.

Share counts: Vista Gold ~150.88M fully diluted, implied by the release (US$427M on a 100% basis ÷ US$2.83); its last reported basic count is 145,971,346. Artemis Gold 233,190,778, last reported. Prices derived from the release: Vista Gold ~US$2.26 last close (US$2.83 less its 25% premium; US$341M ÷ 150.88M agrees); Artemis Gold ~US$29.30 (US$2.83 ÷ 0.0966), so Artemis Gold's announcement market cap is ~US$6,832M.
Liquidity is in each company's reporting currency: Artemis Gold C$879M total liquidity; Vista Gold US$50M cash and no debt (both at Jun 30, 2026). No combined figure is given.

Current prices are the Sep 21, 2026 closes: Artemis Gold C$39.50 (US$28.17 at the Bank of Canada USD/CAD rate of 1.4021) and Vista Gold US$2.74. Market caps multiply these by the share counts above. Announcement figures (market data Sep 18, 2026) are from the release.
Silver is not shown in the ounce rows above: Blackwater also holds 62.3 Moz P&P and 122.4 Moz M&I silver, and Artemis Gold pours both metals.
Metal prices: gold US$4,348.15/oz and silver US$67.04/oz on Sep 18, 2026 (the announcement market-data date); gold US$4,324.25/oz and silver US$65.88/oz on Sep 21, 2026.

Artemis Gold H1 2026 results (Q2 release, Aug 6, 2026): Q2 alone was revenue C$433.6M, adjusted EBITDA C$285.2M, operating cash flow C$207.5M and AISC US$955/oz on record production of 74,063 oz. Growth capital covers Phase 1A (C$120M, 57% complete at Jun 30) and EP2 (C$1.44B). The company holds put options on 172,500 oz at C$5,300/oz to Jun 2027.

Rolling four quarters to Jun 30, 2026 (Artemis Gold): revenue C$1,390.8M, adjusted EBITDA C$897.7M, operating cash flow C$696.9M, capital spend C$433.4M (growth C$400.8M), free cash flow C$263.5M, and C$664.3M before growth capital. Production 265,451 oz, sold 269,358 oz at AISC US$951/oz; spot sales of 169,335 oz realized US$4,093/oz. Sources: the Q3 2025, Q4/FY 2025, Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 results releases.
Vista Gold's four quarters to Jun 30, 2026: net loss US$8.5M and US$7.2M of operating cash used, with US$49.5M cash at Jun 30 after a US$44.9M equity raise in March 2026. No revenue.
